latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Homework Battle Planner.
- Diagnoses key causes of homework resistance (overwhelm, boredom, perfectionism, autonomy-seeking) and provides targeted strategies.
- Designed to support parents in shifting from homework enforcer to study ally.
- Clear safety boundaries: informational guidance only; not a substitute for professional advice, diagnosis, or crisis support.
- Includes step-by-step usage instructions and details on when to use this skill.
